Design system specimen

Every token and primitive of the app, rendered from apps/mobile/constants/design-system.ts. The rules for using them are in docs/design-system.md.

Motion

Cubic ease-out [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], no springs or bounce. Reduced motion removes the movement (here too).

fast120 ms
standard220 ms
slow360 ms
countUp600 ms
celebrate900 ms
